# MediPencil · User manual

2026-10-04 · https://orch.sungah.kr/medipencil/manual

## Getting started · What this PoC does

MediPencil lets you test a family question, staff review, record approval, publication and a permitted family response. Aino, Liisa, Mikko and Koskinen are characters in a synthetic scenario.

On the login screen, choose Liisa(Family), Mikko(Family) or Koskinen(Staff) to open that user’s dashboard. The header shows Name(Role). Log out before choosing another user. This synthetic-data PoC has no password or real identity verification.

The shared server currently uses direct input. STT and LLM are disabled. Use independently created synthetic examples, not real health information, recordings or contact details.

1. Prepare separate browsers or profiles for family and staff, such as Chrome and Safari.
2. Choose Liisa in the family browser and Koskinen in the staff browser. Two tabs in one profile share cookies and do not represent independent users.
3. Use Interface language to choose Suomi, 한국어 or English. Labels, review guidance and this manual follow your selection. The choice is remembered in this browser when local storage is available.

> “Back to work” returns to the previous screen while retaining its inputs in this tab. Reloading, closing the browser, switching workflow screens or changing roles may lose unsaved inputs and the open draft view.

> GitHub site: https://hyosang-ryu.github.io/Team_Medipencil/ . GitHub Pages serves static files; questions, records and comments use the existing shared server database. Pages sessions stay in tab memory, so choose a role again after reloading. Team members do not need a VPN. The cookie-sharing warning for tabs in one profile applies to the original Sungah site; separate browsers remain recommended for role-based review on either site.

> The six colored dashboard cards show record counts over the last 7 days. Compare the hexagon and select a card or chart category to see daily changes. View daily values opens a table. Counts use currently valid records by observation date in Europe/Helsinki; families see only the latest currently shared publication. Plans are included, so these are not health scores or completion rates. Zero means no records; Not shared means excluded.

> Sending a question immediately adds it to My question board with author, time and status. Open a post or read its reply; filter by all, waiting or answered. Staff use Family question board: Write a reply → Review reply → check evidence → Approve reply and prepare publication → review all shared content → Publish reply. Unpublished replies are hidden from family, and changes to evidence or sharing permission hide the reply. Saved questions and published replies remain after reload and login. In-progress editor state before publication is not restored after reload.

## Roles and navigation

Check Current user before taking action. Choosing a role is not authentication of a real person. This manual is available before you select a role.

| Role / menu | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Liisa · family | Ask questions and read permitted published answers and evidence |
| Mikko · family | Test a different sharing scope; may not see the same content as Liisa |
| Koskinen · staff | Use Questions, Record and publish, Consent and Team comments |
| Questions | Schedule review or keep a question unanswered |
| Record and publish | Enter and approve a record, then publish separately for a recipient |
| Consent | Review a candidate for sharing outdoor activity with Mikko or revoke an existing scope |
| Team comments | Save and read usability feedback |
| User manual | Open this guide with or without a selected role |

## A complete first walkthrough

Complete this example in separate family and staff browsers. Add a short test identifier such as TEST-A to the question so other reviewers can distinguish it. Changes on the shared server also affect other reviewers.

1. In Liisa’s browser, enter “TEST-A: Is a walk planned today?” in Question, then choose Send question.
2. In Koskinen’s browser, find it in Questions. Use Keep unanswered if no source supports an answer yet.
3. Open Record and publish, link the question and select Direct processing — no LLM.
4. Enter “A walk with staff is planned after lunch. Completion has not been confirmed.” as Original text. Choose Care worker, Plan — not completed and Outdoor activity.
5. Choose Create draft for review. Check the meaning, speaker, tense and sharing scope. Tick the review confirmation, then choose Approve record.
6. In the publication area below, choose Liisa and Prepare publication. Review the recipient and every preview sentence.
7. Tick the publication review confirmation and choose Publish approved answer. Wait for Published.
8. In Liisa’s browser, read the update and choose Show source. The activity must remain a plan, not a completed walk.

> Direct input does not use AI to summarize or translate your text. Text entered in another language remains in that language in the family view and evidence.

## Family · Board and questions

Select Liisa or Mikko to see Aino’s board, the question form and My questions. The board shows published information allowed by current sharing permissions. An approved record is still hidden until it is published.

1. Read each topic card and its status. Distinguish Not shared with you from No information published.
2. Choose Show source to see the permitted excerpt supporting a statement. This does not expose the entire staff record.
3. Enter one specific question and choose Send question. Blank input is not accepted; the limit is 2,000 characters.
4. Check My questions. Answered requires a successful publication linked to that question.
5. Switch to the other family role to compare sharing scopes. Changing language alone does not change the recipient or permissions.

> Questions are not an emergency contact or a real care-request service. This PoC does not send care notifications or contact messages.

## Staff · Question queue and review time

Choose Koskinen → Questions to read family questions and their status. Enter scheduled review time in your device’s local timezone. Other displayed times use Europe/Helsinki, so the shown clock times may differ.

1. Enter a review time, then choose Schedule review on the relevant question. The button is disabled without a time.
2. Choose Keep unanswered when the available evidence is insufficient.
3. When evidence is ready, open Record and publish and link that question. Reading the queue or scheduling a review does not mark it answered.

## Staff · Direct input, draft edits and approval

The upper part of Record and publish is the staff record workspace. Set the question link, original text, speaker, type and information scope before creating a draft. Do not add facts unsupported by the source.

1. Use Direct processing — no LLM in Draft processing on the current shared PoC.
2. Choose the question in Link to a question. No answer link creates a record without binding it to a specific question.
3. Enter synthetic Original text. Select Resident, Care worker or Unknown according to the actual source.
4. Choose Statement, Observation or Plan. Do not turn a plan into a completed event by selecting Observation.
5. Choose Information scope. Outdoor activity and health information requires both scopes to be permitted for the recipient.
6. Choose Create draft for review and read the draft on the right. Check the source, speaker, negations, tense, numbers, scope and whether it sufficiently answers the linked question.
7. If you edit text, confirm that you checked the new source information and choose Save change. The old source is retained and new evidence is linked.
8. After saving edits, tick the full review confirmation again. Choose Approve record and check the Approved status.

> Approval may be disabled while edits are unsaved, review is unchecked or a request is running. Check whether you need to save an edit and complete the separate source and overall review confirmations.

> Approval is separate from publication and never grants family consent automatically.

## Staff · Publish for a family recipient

The lower area, “4 · Review and publish to family”, handles publication. Prepare and review content for each recipient separately.

1. Choose Liisa or Mikko in Recipient. Changing the recipient clears the previous preview and review checkbox.
2. Choose Prepare publication. The preview uses approved sources and current consent scopes.
3. Check the recipient, each statement, source meaning, plan/observation distinction and sharing scope. If the preview is empty, check approved records and sharing permissions first.
4. Tick the publication review confirmation, then choose Publish approved answer.
5. Wait for Published and check the answer, question status and evidence in that recipient’s browser. Prepare, review and publish separately for another recipient.

> An old preview may conflict after records or consent change. Choose Prepare publication again and review the current content.

## Corrections and confirming a planned activity

Correct an approved record through a new correction version. Do not silently alter old evidence or automatically mark a plan completed.

1. On the Approved record currently open in the workspace, choose Start correction and hide old publication. Related earlier publication content is hidden from the family at this point.
2. Enter the corrected source, confirm you checked it and choose Save change. Complete the overall review and Approve record again.
3. To share the new version, repeat Prepare publication, review and Publish approved answer.
4. To confirm completion of a plan, create and approve a separate supporting observation. Open Confirm planned activity → Load plans, identify the plan and confirm only if the current approved observation genuinely supports that activity.

> The current UI has no full historical record search/reopen list. Test corrections while the approved record is still open. Report the limitation in Team comments if a reload closes a record you need.

> A plan itself cannot prove completion. Family publication still requires a separate review after an activity is confirmed.

## Consent candidates, confirmation and revocation

Choose Koskinen → Consent to work with sharing scopes. The current candidate form is limited to Aino → Mikko for outdoor activity. It is not a general permission-management screen for every recipient and scope.

1. Choose Load consent and sources to fetch current consent versions, scopes and source statements.
2. Select a synthetic Consent source statement that explicitly supports the person and sharing scope. Prepare appropriate source information through the record workflow if none is available.
3. Choose Create candidate: Mikko + outdoor activity. Creating a candidate alone does not change access.
4. Read the recipient, source and proposed scope. Tick the confirmation and choose Confirm limited sharing.
5. To revoke, select Information to revoke and check the target family member. Tick the confirmation and choose Revoke. A recipient without that scope has a disabled button.
6. Check the result in the family browser. Changing permission may still require a separately prepared new publication.

> Outdoor activity does not also grant health_context, medication or sleep. If a statement requires two scopes, both must be allowed.

> This synthetic consent exercise is not a legally validated consent or electronic-signature process.

## Write and read team comments

Select Koskinen and open Team comments. Feedback is stored in this round’s server database. On the public PoC, anyone can choose the staff role and read comments. Aliases are not verified identities.

1. Enter a recognizable test alias in Anonymous reviewer alias (up to 40 characters). Do not use a real name or email address.
2. Choose the relevant Screen under review: overall flow, family board, staff question queue, record/review, publication or consent.
3. Write the blocked action, reproduction steps, expected result, actual result and suggested improvement in Comment (up to 3,000 characters).
4. Choose Save comment and wait for Comment saved. Input is retained after a failure so you can retry the same content.
5. Use Filter by screen and Refresh comments to read recent feedback. The list contains the latest 200 entries for the selected scope.

> Example: “QA-A / Publication / Choose Liisa → preview → publish / Expected: an obvious success message / Actual: missed the message below the fold / Suggestion: show status near the button.”

> Attachments, threaded replies, notifications and edit/delete menus are not implemented. Distinguish automated comments such as AUTO-SA-DEPLOY from actual human feedback. Saving a comment does not confirm a fix or completed validation.

## Statuses and terminology

| Label | Meaning and next step |
| --- | --- |
| Received | Question received; awaiting staff review |
| Review scheduled | A review time is planned; the question is not yet answered |
| Awaiting an answer | Leave open until sufficient evidence is available |
| Answered | A linked answer has been successfully published |
| Draft | Awaiting review or being edited; not published to family |
| Approved | Record reviewed by staff; publication is a separate step |
| Published | Published for a recipient; current access is checked on reading |
| Plan | Intended activity, not evidence of completion |
| Not shared with you | The selected family member lacks the required sharing scope |
| No information recorded | No publication to show; does not establish a normal or abnormal condition |
| CACHED / REPLAY | Saved publication or a previous request result, not a new AI execution |

## Troubleshooting · Disabled buttons or missing content

First note the current role, screen, button and error message. Wait for a request to finish before repeated clicks, and preserve unsaved text before reloading.

| Symptom / error | What to check |
| --- | --- |
| Approve button disabled | Save changed text, confirm the new source and complete the overall review checkbox |
| Family answer missing | Check Published, not just Approved; verify the recipient and required scopes |
| Question missing | Check the browser role and My questions scope. Wait briefly, then reload/select the role again if needed |
| SESSION_REQUIRED / SESSION_CHANGED | The session may have expired or another tab changed roles. Select the intended role again |
| CSRF_INVALID | The session may be stale. Preserve input, select the role again and retry |
| ROLE_FORBIDDEN / RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND | The current role/recipient is not permitted, or correction/revocation hid the item. Do not bypass recipient boundaries |
| REVISION_CONFLICT / stale preview | Another reviewer may have changed data. Reload current information and prepare publication again |
| PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED | AI is disabled on the shared PoC. Return to Direct processing — no LLM |
| Network or storage failure | After reconnecting, check whether the result was saved. Retry comments using retained input. Report persistent errors with reproduction steps |
| Evidence disappears | Correction, revocation or a permission change may have hidden it. Check the current state instead of relying on an earlier view |

## Languages, AI and persistence

Interface language offers separate Finnish, Korean and English labels, guidance and manuals. The choice is remembered in this browser when local storage is available. Switching language preserves the current input and role. Submitted questions, records, comments and evidence are not translated. The publication content channel remains Finnish; Korean and English publication translation is not implemented.

Publication language on the family board is separate from interface language. Swedish is not yet available and shows a missing-publication message. Language changes do not change identity or sharing permissions.

STT and LLM do not run on the current shared PoC. Visible Local LLM or audio controls do not mean a provider is connected. Continue with direct input. Audio recording permission is separate from consent to share information with family.

Successfully saved questions, approved records, publications and comments persist in the server database. Unsaved text and the open workspace are not guaranteed to be saved automatically. You may need to select a role again after reloading.

Reviewers in the same round share server data. There is no personal reset button. Ask the operator if a new test round is needed.

## Before finishing your review

Passing automated tests is different from feedback from a person using the product. After following the guide, describe your own experience.

1. Did the family question reach the staff browser?
2. Did drafts and approval remain hidden until publication?
3. Did the intended family recipient see the published answer and evidence?
4. Did the planned walk remain a plan rather than becoming completed?
5. Could you understand Liisa/Mikko sharing differences and the effect of revocation?
6. Did you record the blocked screen, steps, expected/actual result and improvement suggestion in Team comments?
